payload.title: docs/how-to/write-verify-for-a-skill-prose-change.md is missing check-decision-citation-drift.mjs…
payload.description: docs/how-to/write-verify-for-a-skill-prose-change.md is missing check-decision-citation-drift.mjs as a known trap for skill-prose verify commands. The how-to lists five traps for writing verify commands on skill-prose changes (rename ~200 files, tsk-f38) but never mentions scripts/check-decision-citation-drift.mjs, which flags bare D<n> citations (e.g. "D5") outside their own CONTEXT.md (message cites "decision 0017 -- inline the content, delete the id"). Live repro from tsk-4lh (2026-08-27): followed this how-to exactly to write verify for editing fgos-coding-validating/SKILL.md and fgos-coding-implement/references/worker-contract-and-orient.md, wrote text citing "(tsk-40m D5)", passed the local grep/npm-test checks the how-to prescribed, but fgos return's own full-suite npm test (4180 tests, only run at return/catchup time, ~2.5min) caught test/scripts/check-decision-citation-drift.test.mjs failing on exactly this pattern in all 4 real mirror copies (.agents/skills/**, plugins/fgOS/skills/**). Cost one full blocked -> take -> fix -> return cycle to recover. Fix scope: add this check as a sixth documented trap in docs/how-to/write-verify-for-a-skill-prose-change.md (pattern: never cite a bare D<digits> token outside a CONTEXT.md file in skill prose; either drop the id and inline the content, or run `node scripts/check-decision-citation-drift.mjs --skills-dir .agents/skills --skills-dir plugins/fgOS/skills` locally before relying on npm test's slower full-suite catch). Low risk, docs-only.

payload.title: fgos return/approve's internal check emits "grep config error: unknown encoding: <pattern>" to…
payload.description: fgos return/approve's internal check emits "grep config error: unknown encoding: <pattern>" to stderr when an item's verify command contains an rg -E '<regex>' clause, apparently misparsing the verify string's own regex as a grep/rg config encoding argument. Live repro from tsk-4lh (2026-08-27, second successful fgos return call): the item's verify field included "! rg --hidden -lE '\b(ADR|RUL|D)[0-9]{1,4}\b' <files>" as a real regression guard; the background return's own stdout captured the literal line "grep config error: unknown encoding: \b(ADR|RUL|D)[0-9]{1,4}\b" alongside "frozenJudgeHits": [] and "footprintDiffHits": [] in the JSON result -- both empty, and the call still exited 0 / landed the item at awaiting-approval, so this did not block anything this time. Root cause likely lives in src/runner/frozen-judge.mjs (same module tsk-5kt already flags for silently missing a real out-of-footprint file via footprintDiffHits) -- worth investigating whether this subsystem could silently miss a real finding (empty result on an internal error, rather than empty result on a genuine no-match). Scope: in src/runner/frozen-judge.mjs, find why a verify-field regex gets passed as a grep/rg encoding argument, and either fix the misuse or make the failure loud instead of silently returning an empty array.
